# Pull request

## Outcome

What problem does this solve? Describe the resulting behavior and scope.

## Validation

List commands and results. Identify skipped checks and explain why.

## Operational impact and rollback

Describe affected hosts, access, persistence and rollback, or state repository-only.

## Checklist

- [ ] Focused Conventional Commits; no co-author trailers
- [ ] Relevant validation passes and no secrets are included
- [ ] Documentation matches implemented behavior
- [ ] Deployment and rollback are documented if applicable
